title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
source: curated summary - authentic text at the India Code URL
note: In force from 1 July 2024. Replaced the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.

sections.heading: Evidence may be given of facts in issue and relevant facts
sections.text: Corresponds to section 5 of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: Admission defined
sections.text: Corresponds to section 17 of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: Opinion of experts
sections.text: Corresponds to section 45 of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: Primary evidence
sections.text: Corresponds to section 62 of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: Secondary evidence
sections.text: Corresponds to section 63 of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: Electronic or digital record
sections.text: Electronic records are not to be denied admissibility solely on the ground of being electronic. No direct Evidence Act equivalent.

sections.heading: Admissibility of electronic records
sections.text: Conditions for admitting computer output, with a certificate requirement. Corresponds to section 65B of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: Burden of proof
sections.text: Corresponds to section 101 of the Evidence Act.

sections.heading: Presumption as to abetment of suicide by a married woman
sections.text: Corresponds to section 113A of the Evidence Act.
